# Release notes / 发布说明

> Convention: `.github/releases/vX.Y.Z.md` — bilingual (English + 中文) notes,
> attached to the GitHub Release automatically by the publish workflow.

## [0.1.5] — 2026-08-27

### EN
- `audit --clean-stale` rewrites all stale rows in one flock+awk pass (1 ssh round-trip instead of N), keeping the mktemp + in-place write semantics.
- Local port-exhaustion diagnostics: one netstat + one tasklist (or one lsof) for the whole range instead of a spawn per port.
- Peer/dev aligned to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cmdline ^0.1.2-alpha.3` (no more UNMET PEER warning on current harness alphas).
- `test/` no longer shipped in the npm package; added English registry-format doc; refreshed an outdated README troubleshooting row.

### 中文
- `audit --clean-stale` 现在用一次 flock+awk 批量改写全部 stale 行(N 行 = 1 次 ssh 往返),保持 mktemp + 原地写语义。
- 本地端口耗尽诊断:整个区间只跑一次 netstat + 一次 tasklist(POSIX 一次 lsof),不再每端口起进程。
- peer/dev 依赖对齐 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cmdline ^0.1.2-alpha.3`(当前 harness alpha 下不再有 UNMET PEER 警告)。
- npm 包不再携带 `test/`;新增英文版登记表格式文档;精简 README 过时排障行。
